about: 3,000 years in 40 seconds: structure short 7 (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-30-structure-shorts-design.md). A terminal log, the year ticking over, one entry per page; Blender: a slow push along a corridor of dates (blender/searchlight.py). Queued overnight 2026-10-01. Draft 1, copy only.
hexagramNote: the end card and its track come from 22, as in the two lessons, so the terminal pieces end alike
style: The header reads 'SIX LINES // READY FOR INQUIRY' throughout. Each query clears the screen like a filmbook page. The query is typed after '>' (dim green); the answer types out below it (bright green, 48 px); the part of the readout the answer is about is drawn beside it, alone. Chapter pages: a single word, centred, held 2 s. Own names only, never MU/TH/UR or INTERFACE 2037.

music.why: calm, 92 bpm, A# minor, from 8 s as on 4, 22, 26 and 41; no other structure short uses it

caption: How the I Ching travelled: from legend to a 1950 English translation and a 1962 novel.

pages.q: HOW OLD IS THE I CHING
pages.a:
PARTS ARE ABOUT 3,000 YEARS OLD.
HERE IS HOW IT TRAVELLED.

FU XI DRAWS THE EIGHT TRIGRAMS.
NO DATE. A STORY.

TRADITION: KING WEN
WRITES THE 64 TEXTS.

SHAO YONG ORDERS THE 64
IN A SQUARE AND A CIRCLE.

BOUVET SENDS THAT DIAGRAM
TO LEIBNIZ IN GERMANY.

CARL JUNG WRITES THE FOREWORD
TO WILHELM'S TRANSLATION
IN ENGLISH.

PHILIP K. DICK PUBLISHES
THE MAN IN THE HIGH CASTLE,
PLOTTED WITH THE I CHING.
